label: Folio
description: Personal developer blog and portfolio inspired by leerob.com, overreacted.io, brittanychiang.com and antfu.me with a narrow reading column, serif article text, warm neutrals with one green accent, automatic light and dark mode with a toggle, writing grouped by year, reading time, a sticky outline on posts, previous and next posts, project tiles with tech pills, an experience timeline and Person markup for search engines

name.hint: Your full name, shown as logo and author of the posts

job.label: Job title
job.hint: Your role used for search engines, e.g. Staff Engineer

company.label: Company
company.hint: Company or organization you work for, e.g. Northwind Labs

location.label: Location
location.hint: City or region you live in, e.g. Berlin, Germany

avatar.label: Photo
avatar.hint: Square photo or avatar of you shown below the posts

bio.label: Short bio
bio.hint: One sentence about you shown below every post, e.g. I build Laravel apps and write about databases

email.label: E-mail
email.hint: E-mail address shown in the footer with a copy button

links.label: Profiles
links.hint: Links to your profiles shown in the footer, e.g. GitHub, Mastodon or LinkedIn

label.hint: Name of the website, e.g. GitHub

url.hint: Link to your profile, e.g. https://github.com/lena

--pico-font-family-sans-serif.hint: Comma separated list of fonts used for the text
--pico-font-family-sans-serif.default: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

--pico-contrast.hint: Color of elements with strong contrast to the background

--pico-contrast-hover.hint: Contrast color when hovering or focusing an element

--pico-contrast-inverse.hint: Text color on elements using the contrast color

--pico-primary.hint: Main brand color used for links and buttons

--pico-primary-background.hint: Background color of primary buttons and highlights

--pico-primary-hover.hint: Primary color when hovering or focusing an element

--pico-primary-hover-background.hint: Primary background color when hovering or focusing an element

--pico-secondary.hint: Additional color used for less important links and buttons

--pico-secondary-hover.hint: Secondary color when hovering or focusing an element

--pico-secondary-hover-background.hint: Secondary background color when hovering or focusing an element

--pico-border-radius.hint: Rounding of corners as CSS length, e.g. 0.5rem or 0 for sharp corners

--pico-nav-breadcrumb-divider.hint: Character shown between the breadcrumb links
